source.rightsEvidence: Requester-approved project clearance for retaining this reference's full-page desktop/mobile screenshots, derived design prompt, and pipeline-model visual-reference use. No source-owner grant or license was supplied; see rights/requester-attestation.md.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A visual, community-forward hair studio experience. A compact, low-chrome navigation sits over an edge-to-edge moving image of a hair-art process, followed by large white editorial chapters pairing brief studio context with expressive portrait photography. Rather than a repeated card grid, the page alternates copy fields and full-height portraits, then shifts into a concise social-proof rail, a centered community signup, and a dark utility footer. The source combines black and white space with bright chromatic accents and unusual hair imagery. Transfer the pacing, image/copy contrast, and expressive portrait role only. Create a distinct client palette and identity, use approved or generated images, and do not copy the source's name, exact rainbow wordmark, people, text, testimonials, contact information, or exact visual styling.

heroGeometry.alignment: full-bleed hair image with a small restrained identity/navigation layer; avoid placing a large copy card over the focal subject
heroGeometry.viewport: image-led first screen with a clear, accessible booking route and a readable one-line service promise nearby

navigationGeometry.mode: compact wordmark and minimal icon/section controls
navigationGeometry.placement: quiet top edge integrated with the opening image rather than a large pill container
navigationGeometry.mobile: small brand mark with a clearly named menu control and a separate accessible booking action; no icon-only ambiguity

typography.display: confident geometric grotesk or custom-feeling rounded display sans, selected from available licensed/system stacks
typography.body: clear neutral sans for service and visit information
typography.scale: short all-caps labels, oversized editorial phrases, compact centered story copy, touch-legible mobile text

palette.ink: near-black with readable white-on-dark utility text
palette.contrastIntent: playful and expressive without sacrificing legibility; never rely on a rainbow gradient or pale accent text for essential copy

imageTreatment.mode: large editorial portraits, close hair-detail crops, and selective studio atmosphere
imageTreatment.crop: full-bleed opening media followed by alternating contained portrait crops; subject-safe on small screens
imageTreatment.focalPoint: hair silhouette, texture, color, and self-expression; no generated subject may be presented as the client's real team or customer

servicePresentation.pattern: visual service discovery supported by a concise, accessible service index; describe actual client services with short scope notes rather than copying a source service menu
servicePresentation.interaction: real service links or a touch-safe gallery rail; booking links work and do not require hover; service facts and inclusivity language come only from approved client tokens

ctaPlacement.primary: a visible booking or consultation route in the opening navigation and after the first editorial chapter
ctaPlacement.secondary: a service-discovery or gallery route near the hero promise
ctaPlacement.early: within the first viewport without covering the subject or obscuring a full-page image

motion.primitive: optional short process film or still-image sequence with an explicit poster/fallback; one restrained image reveal or touch-safe review rail
motion.library: native CSS transitions or one narrowly scoped GSAP sequence only when it improves the story
motion.reducedMotion: replace moving imagery with a poster, disable scroll-triggered transforms, and keep every service, action, and text chapter visible

mobileRecomposition.strategy: image-first editorial stack with independent copy chapters and compact controls
rules: keep the opening media subject visible and reserve a non-overlapping text/action zone
stack each alternating image and copy chapter in an intentional sequence rather than shrinking desktop columns
convert the proof rail into a touch-safe horizontal carousel or vertically readable quotes
make navigation and booking controls explicit, accessible, and at least 44 CSS px when actionable
remove source-like 15 px body overflow and verify document and body widths equal the viewport

prohibitedPatterns: copying the Fruittii identity, exact rainbow wordmark/colors, source page copy, source photography, testimonials, names, contact details, or overall trade dress
reusing any source person as the client's stylist, employee, or customer, or implying generated imagery depicts the client's real work
inventing client services, stylist credentials, inclusivity commitments, prices, hours, locations, review scores, or appointment availability
replacing the distinct editorial image/copy rhythm with a generic split hero or repeated rounded-card wall
autoplay-only motion, unlabelled icon controls, hover-only service content, clipped focal subjects, or horizontal overflow

requiredSignatureElements.description: A full-bleed, subject-led opening image or video poster paired with a compact identity and a real early booking route.
At least two intentional portrait/copy chapters with changing image placement and generous white space, not generic cards.
A distinct late-page community or proof moment that transitions into a clear contact/visit close, using only verified client material.

acceptanceChecks: desktop and mobile retain the edge-to-edge image opening and alternating editorial chapter rhythm
the page remains a hair/beauty business reference, not a medical aesthetics or clinical-treatment template
at least one real booking/contact action is visible early and all booking links work
client services, inclusivity claims, reviews, team facts, addresses, hours, and prices are sealed to verified intake values
motion has a still/reduced-motion fallback and does not hide essential content
no source name, exact wordmark, source photograph, quote, reviewer, or source-specific claim is reused
rendered body and document widths match both desktop and mobile viewports

review.scope: Official homepage and story page inspected, responsive full-page screenshots captured at desktop and mobile, business category verified from first-party content, and source overflow disclosed. Not added to or approved for a production niche pool.
